values.note: Run by the Denton Go concession, not on the state parks' ReserveAmerica system (DCNR: 'Currently, this park has no reservable facilities'). RV sites book through Denton Go's Firefly Reservations page; phone (814) 754-9013.

note: DCNR state park campground (Nine Mile Loop) along Nine Mile Run, operated by the Denton Go concession under DCNR. Currently 10 rustic back-in gravel RV sites with electric (DCNR says 11); flush toilets and warm showers in the Adventure Center. Reservable online through Denton Go, not ReserveAmerica. One of PA's highest parks; max RV length not published outside the booking engine. --Claude
summary: Confirmed flush toilets and showers (in the Adventure Center), reservable through the operator (Denton Go's Firefly engine). Changed sites 11 -> 10 (Denton Go: 'currently 10 RV sites'; DCNR still says 11), all back-in. Amperage, rates, season and RV length not on the public pages (Firefly needs a browser search behind reCAPTCHA).
